mapper.select: SELECT id, scene_code, channel, template_name, description, subject, body_content, require_fields, provider_template_code, im_message_type, channel_defaults_json, priority, status, create_time, update_time, update_user, create_user, version, remark FROM sys_message_template WHERE scene_code = #{sceneCode} AND channel = #{channel} AND status = 1 AND priority = (SELECT MAX(priority) FROM sys_message_template WHERE scene_code = #{sceneCode} AND channel = #{channel} AND status = 1) LIMIT 1

SELECT id, scene_code AS templateCode, template_name, description, subject, priority, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user FROM sys_message_template
channel = 'EMAIL'
